$comment: Glossary for L-13 (doc 06 §3.7, §4.3; doc 08 §7.2; R64). Sources: doc 08 §7.2.1 tables T-A–T-E (en column = the app's own names), §7.2.2 website rules ①–② and the finalized en copy deck (doc 08 §2).

required: key path → value that must be used verbatim (the app's names for kickers, quota-table rows and the 'More Definitions' link; doc 06 §4.2 says features[].kicker and pricing.table.rows.* must equal the glossary). doc 08 §7.2.5 calls this map appNames; both names are accepted.
contains: key path → app button / setting names the sentence must quote verbatim (rule ①: 'in the app, tap …').

banned: variants that must not appear in any leaf value (pattern = literal text unless regex:true; matching is case-sensitive unless flags contains 'i'; allowInKeys exempts key paths, e.g. the Chrome extension pages where mouse wording is correct).

banned.note: touch gesture, not a mouse double-click (doc 08 §7.2.2 X7)
lookup is a double tap, never a tap (doc 08 §1.1 lookup row)
the gesture is a right swipe (F14)
